title: One preserved old multi-step form
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Continue an old multi-step form; detect lost answers, invalid prior tokens, or duplicate submission.

sourceContract.readmeRow: | S133 | **Multi-step form:** Preserve answers, validation state, and submission across deployments. |
sourceContract.backlogRow: | D-S133 | P1 | Add a multi-step form with prior validation/token/session state and cutover between steps. | Answers, validation, permissions, and one final submission survive the transition. | D-S036, D-S037 |
sourceContract.acceptance: Answers, validation, permissions, and one final submission survive the transition.
sourceContract.portableRow: | A-S133 | D-S133 | S | Continue an old multi-step form; detect lost answers, invalid prior tokens, or duplicate submission. | SOURCE |
sourceContract.nativeSiblingRow: | B-S133 | D-S133 | S | Conduct one form journey across versions; verify state, validation, permissions, and one final effect. | CORE, DATA, HOST |
sourceContract.tokenCompatibility: Valid old anti-forgery tokens must remain valid without weakening validation; only fixed fictional token DATA is used here.
sourceContract.sessionCompatibility: Existing session payloads must remain readable; only fixed fictional session DATA is used here.

preconditions: Open this standalone local index.html in a JavaScript-capable browser.
Use only the nine fixed fictional teaching presets; no actual user answers, tokens, sessions, identity or credentials.
The original v1 form has paper-star and violet answers, valid prior validation, fictional token/session/identity bindings and continue/submit permissions.
Cutover occurs between old step and final step; HTTP and effects below are DATA ONLY, not actual operations.

verification.iac: N/A evaluated after genuine assertion RED and before implementation; no resource or infrastructure operation.
verification.deliberateCapture: Exact CAPTURE_BROWSER_EVIDENCE=1 only; unique append-only raw proof. Normal verification is READ-ONLY.
verification.browser: Microsoft-signed Edge 156.0.4314.50, isolated headless session with awaited finally close
verification.lifecycleLimit: Published helper retains known unattended context/page/cleanup lifecycle limitations; inactive recovery prototype is unqualified.
verification.retainedFailure: The first actual browser capture failed the form-action observation: Edge denied a top-frame data URL before a CSP-specific violation was available. Its raw failure and source snapshots are retained, not counted as green. The corrected test-only empty form targets the current local file to observe the actual CSP denial without data transmission.

limits: No real user data, form journey, authentication, token validation, session persistence, network, storage, submission or business effect.
No cloud, IaC, scaffold, identity registration, credentials, deployment, spend, packages, framework or root/shared integration changes.
All versions and HTTP responses are fixed fictional DATA, not actual deployment or HTTP observations.
Finite deterministic steps and counts are teaching bounds, not elapsed-time, capacity, latency or reliability evidence.
No Microsoft SLA, endorsement, full accessibility certification, native qualification, source-parent completion or additional Kano credit.
